CAMEL-16577.title: camel-splunk-hec - Add support for setting the timestamp on events
CAMEL-16577.description:
h2. Problem

Events that come in an Integration may define the time of which that event occurred. An Integration developer cannot use a message's timestamp as the index time.

h2. Solution

Add support to set the index time.

commits.message: CAMEL-16577 add support to set the index time
commits.author: dgilmor-rei

commits.message: CAMEL-16577 added header overrides and examples for overriding the index time
commits.author: dgilmor-rei

CAMEL-16390.title: camel-salesforce: Add raw operation
CAMEL-16390.description: This will be a new `raw` operation that allows users to specify URL, URL parameters, http body, and http method. This will allow a lot more flexibility in using the salesforce APIs with raw payloads.

commits.message: Improve documentation, fix some option handling.
commits.author: jeremyross

CAMEL-16738.title: camel-websocket - Support for websocket subprotocols
CAMEL-16738.description: I would like to see camel-websocket support subprotocols as per RFC 6455, during connection upgrade negotiation.  Ideally we could specify the subprotocol(s) that our application supports via a subprotocol option in the component/endpoint URI.  If camel-websocket accepts a subprotocol proposed by a connecting client, then the client should be informed of the agreed subprotocol via HTTP header (as per RFC 6455), and the agreed subprotocol should also be provided as a message header via the camel-subprotocol consumer.

commits.message: [CAMEL-16739] camel-websocket now adds header with URL relative path
commits.author: pgalbraith

CAMEL-13180.title: camel-salesforce - Apex calls could support more flexible response parsing
CAMEL-13180.description:
The current approach requires following a very strict format for error codes other than 2xx. This isn't necessarily the case, though, for custom apex classes.

Ideally, it would be possible to (optionally) handle the parsing in the camel route itself.

CAMEL-17706.title: camel-azure-servicebus: Add fullyQualifiedNamespace and tokenCredential to Azure ServiceBus component
CAMEL-17706.description: Add the option to pass a fully qualified namespace and token credential parameter to the azure-servicebus component as uri parameters. The use case would be to use AzureAD authentication rather than using a connection string, and allow for configuration for more than one service bus namespace and better security. Currently that configuration is cumbersome, needed to instantiate an async client for each queue to be sent to/received from. Passing those configuration options to the endpoint would greatly simplify that configuration.

commits.message: CAMEL-17706: add fqns and credential parameter, update variable name, update validation, add test
commits.author: matt
